assembly_convention.cli_liftover_wiring: assign-ancestry CLI exposes no --liftover/--chain option; annotate_catalogue calls assign_from_source(...) without a liftover; GwasVcfReader.liftover defaults to None, so extract_at_sites builds a -R regions file from the hg38 reference ALIDs and queries the hg19 VCF at those coordinates.
assembly_convention.consequence: The assign-ancestry NNLS output for ukb-b is NOT interpretable as ancestry evidence: source and reference coordinates were never aligned. af_overlap 29,825-45,484 out of 5,810,530 reference sites (~0.5-0.8%) is consistent with coincidental allele matches at unaligned positions. The 10/10 gate_reason=residual and the eaf_orientation=passed values are artifacts of the assembly mismatch, not a gate/calibration finding.
assembly_convention.library_liftover_support: opengwasdb.ancestry.mixture.assign_from_source(..., liftover=load_liftover(chain_file=...)) is the documented GRCh37 GWAS-VCF -> GRCh38 reference path; when liftover is set, extract_at_sites does a full unrestricted scan and lifts each row before computing its canonical ALID.
assembly_convention.source_assembly: GRCh37/hg19 (ukb-b VCF ##contig assembly=GRCh37; verified in ukb-b-10001 header)

assign_ancestry.finding: All 10 read with af_overlap 29825-45484 and correct EAF orientation (eaf_orientation=passed, r 0.83-0.88), dominant superpop EUR 0.876-0.928, but every one gated Unassigned with gate_reason=residual because the NNLS residual exceeds --residual-max 0.06. The existing route is technically supported for VCF; the residual gate (a registry/calibration decision, same values as the c128 config) needs review for ukb-b.

code_branch_proof: opengwasdb/build/resolve.py requires MetricsReader; GwasVcfReader is not one, so resolve-analyses structurally rejects VCF. assign-ancestry defaults to opengwasdb.gwas-vcf and estimate-phenotype-sd resolves a SourceReader; both are documented and covered by tests/test_assign_ancestry_cli.py and tests/test_estimate_phenotype_sd_cli.py.

estimate_phenotype_sd.note: A first run with original_sd_method=declared_standardised was refused by design: the command only computes estimated_from_beta_distribution / estimated_from_reference_maf / estimated_from_source_maf and leaves the tier to the caller. Re-run with estimated_from_source_maf (source AF, no reference panel needed).

projection_at_2_workers.basis: measured wall time on the 10-Analysis pilot, linear extrapolation, same 2 workers

trial: 10 representative ukb-b Analyses via the separate supported core commands (NOT resolve-analyses)

validity.assign_ancestry: INVALID for ancestry interpretation (GRCh37 source vs GRCh38 reference, no liftover applied). The command itself completed within budget and produced a Catalogue.
validity.estimate_phenotype_sd: VALID as a source-MAF SD estimate: --af-source source is assembly-independent for the se/af evidence; it read a bounded evidence sample (~25 MB, 47,960 512-byte blocks), not a full scan.

verdict: The separate CLI route natively supports VCF, but for ukb-b it is assembly-incompatible as invoked: the CLI must gain liftover wiring (or the registry must pre-lift / use the core library API with the chain) before its NNLS output can be interpreted. No gate was loosened and no full-2514 run was launched.
